buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) For Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Split Air Conditioners The following Additional Terms and Conditions shall be applicable to all participating bidders: 1. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) The bidder must submit a valid Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) on its official letterhead. The MAF must clearly mention the authorized firm's name, c omplete address, GeM Bid Number and Bid Date. Generic authorization letters shall not be accepted. 2. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) The bidder must submit the required EMD physically to the Buyer Department on or before the bid closing date and time, wherever physical submission is expressly permitted under the applicable GeM bid conditio ns. Any exemption shall be considered only as per applicable GeM rules. 3. Local Service Support The bidder must provide details of its local authorized service centre, including complete address, contact person, mobile number and customer support numbers, to ensure timely installation and after-sales servic e. 4. Escalation Matrix The bidder must submit a complete escalation matrix containing the names, designations, contact number s and email addresses of service personnel at Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 for complaint resolution. 5. Non-Blacklisting Certificate The bidder must submit a duly signed and stamped declaration on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100, wh erever legally applicable, confirming that the firm has not been blacklisted, debarred or suspended by any Government Department, PSU or other Government organization. 6. BIS and ISO Certification The bidder must submit valid and applicable BIS certification and ISO certification of the OEM for the offere d products or relevant manufacturing operations, as specified in the bid. The offered air conditioners must comply with applicable Indian Standards and statutory requirements. 7. OEM Technical Compliance Sheet The bidder must submit a detailed technical compliance sheet on the OEM's official letterhead, duly signed and stamped by the authorized OEM representative, confirming compliance with all technical specification s mentioned in the bid. 8. Breakdown and Complaint Resolution The bidder shall ensure that all service complaints and equipment breakdowns are attended to within 24 h ours of complaint registration. Failure to attend within the stipulated period shall attract penalties as specif ied in the bid or contract. Rectification timelines shall be governed by the applicable warranty and service- level conditions. 9. GST Registration and Local Office The bidder must submit a valid GST registration certificate. Where specifically justified by the procurement requirements and permissible under applicable GeM rules, the bidder shall provide details of its registered

office or service establishment within the state of delivery, along with documentary evidence. 10. Mandatory Submission of Documents All applicable certificates, declarations, authorization letters, compliance sheets and service support detail s must be uploaded with the technical bid. Failure to submit mandatory documents may result in rejection of the bid, subject to applicable GeM provisions. .
